relation: closed vertex balls and seed-set balls of a simple graph: the seven local Fixpoints X20/X39/X113/X116/X146/X26/X111 x*_ball (radius 0 the centre, each step adding the neighbours of the previous ball) equal the existing GTBase.base.ball r x pointwise, by induction on the radius (not a conversion: distinct fixpoints); the five local x*_set_ball (\bigcup_(x in S) x*_ball r x) equal GTBase.balls.set_ball r S. Set equalities, with no connectedness, nonempty-host, positive-radius or small-radius guard. ball r x = rel_ball (--) r x exactly (ball_rel_ballE); balls never leave the centre's component, so they differ from the truncated graph_dist sublevel sets once r >= #|G| on a disconnected graph, and no unconditional distance bridge is stated.
summary: Batch A, family A22 (closed vertex balls and seed-set balls), on the fixed A21 pin 1b8126b (no private union). The vertex canonical is the existing GTBase.base.ball, byte-exact with its Section discharge (G only); base gains only its evidence lemmas ball0, ballS and ball_center. The new GTBase.balls names the seed-set ball set_ball r S (\bigcup_(x in S) ball r x) with radius monotonicity, the exact specialization ball_rel_ballE of graph_metric.rel_ball, and the empty/zero/singleton/union/monotone seed-set views. The seven local ball Fixpoints now unfold to ball r x and the five set balls to set_ball r S (set equalities by radius induction). The public client: zero radius, centre, monotonicity, rel_ball, the seed-set views, the empty graph, an edgeless host at every radius, and a disconnected host where graph_dist is 2 but no ball reaches.

Frozen verbatim at 1b8126b: the twelve sources, the sixteen reaching chains (X20 burning cover; X39, X116, X146 and X26 pairwise distant paths and k paths; X113 distant cycles and k cycles; X146 hitting; X111 transversal, packing, tau and nu) and the eight rows (GTMisc X20, X39, X40, X113, X116, X146; Packing X26, X111). Complete rows at the pre-migration 9e03072: X39, X40 and X116 (B1+B5), X113 (B1+B10, with B10's forest-after chain), X146 (B1) and X26 (B1+B5), each with their complete chains: 14 whole-row iffs in all. Quantifier orders, guards, truncated radii, natural subtractions, X26's d = 0 reading and X111's arg-min default and exact tau/nu values are unchanged.

History: B1's, B5's and B10's GTMisc and Packing snapshots keep live ball names byte for byte and are documented below; A22's per-row copies keep their live names, with reciprocal notes in their specs. Proof consumers: vocabulary_packing.x26_ballE and the five earlier certificate modules keep their types; vocabulary_misc and M1's GTMisc simple_edges recompile unchanged. rel_ball, the ambient radius_at_most, the internal ball_in and X161's chromatic invariant stay distinct.

This family's complete X39/X40/X26 proofs already use those exact adapters and remain byte-identical. All fourteen whole iff and65 frozen mappings are preserved; the three newer B26 partial rows are recorded explicitly.

Already migrated elsewhere on this prerequisite: GTMisc X128/X139 radius_at_most are the C16 ambient-radius predicates with a centre in the supplied set and truncated graph_dist (including the retained X139 defect), while Minor X220 ball_in is the C18 internal-ball predicate whose walks stay inside the supplied set.
